## Change

Describe one problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue when relevant.

## Evidence

For a method or language change, include source/version, read scope, rights notes, relevant rules, examples, and review status. Keep both README files aligned when either changes.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Separate repository checks from model or host testing.

## Review and merge

Record the final-diff review and CI results. For an owner-authorized private-stage self-merge, disclose that this is an author review rather than independent approval.

## Limitations

State unperformed checks, compatibility gaps, and migration or data risks when relevant.
